title: Refactor AddItemSheet picker binding to use state directly
description: Remove the custom `aislePickerBinding` computed property from AddItemSheet and bind the aisle Picker directly to `$selectedAisle` without changing picker style or EditItemSheet behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No aisle picker style changes are introduced.
Only AddItemSheet is changed for this binding refactor.

handoff_summary.completed: Deleted `aislePickerBinding` (9-line computed Binding). Updated Picker `selection:` argument from `aislePickerBinding` to `$selectedAisle`. Only AddItemSheet.swift was touched.
handoff_summary.remaining: None for this bead. Note: `isAisleManuallySelected` / `isAutoDetected` states remain but are no longer written by the picker — that side-effect is intentionally removed per spec. Any downstream handling of manual selection tracking belongs to a sibling bead.
handoff_summary.risks: The picker no longer sets `isAisleManuallySelected = true` on user selection, so `onChange(of: itemText)` auto-detect can override a manually-chosen aisle. Whether this is intentional for the feature is a concern for review or a follow-up bead.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the picker functions correctly and auto-detect behavior is acceptable with the direct binding.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low. Only AddItemSheet.swift was changed; no shared files touched.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: The computed `Binding` wrapper was the sole mechanism setting `isAisleManuallySelected = true` from picker interaction. Removing it leaves those flags only settable via `performAutoDetect`. This matches the acceptance criteria exactly.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Test execution delegated to tester agent.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: With direct binding, manual aisle selection no longer suppresses subsequent auto-detect runs (isAisleManuallySelected stays false after user taps the picker). This is a functional behaviour change that the tester and reviewer should validate against product intent.

conflict_risks: Low. Only AddItemSheet.swift was changed; no shared files touched.

execution_history.summary: Removed the `aislePickerBinding` computed property from AddItemSheet and changed the aisle Picker to bind directly to `$selectedAisle`. No picker style or other behavioral changes were made.
